fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.description: Required contact mailbox, shared across languages.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone
fields.description: Optional display number. Callable numbers use 3–20 ASCII digits, an optional leading +, and spaces, hyphens, parentheses or periods. Other display text appears without a telephone link. Do not guess a country code.

fields.name: address
fields.label: Address
fields.description: Optional address text; translate it for each language. Line breaks are preserved.

fields.name: instagram
fields.label: Instagram URL
fields.description: Optional HTTPS URL on instagram.com or one of its subdomains. Leave blank to hide this channel.

fields.name: linkedin
fields.label: LinkedIn URL
fields.description: Optional HTTPS URL on linkedin.com or one of its subdomains. Leave blank to hide this channel.

fields.name: facebook
fields.label: Facebook URL
fields.description: Optional HTTPS URL on facebook.com or one of its subdomains. Leave blank to hide this channel.

fields.name: whatsapp
fields.label: WhatsApp international number
fields.description: Optional international number: + followed by 8–15 digits, for example +302101234567. Use no spaces or separators; do not enter a URL or guess a country code. Leave blank to hide WhatsApp.

fields.name: showInHeader
fields.label: Show social icons in header
fields.description: Show configured social channels in the header. Off by default.
